limitations: One baseline and one final 34-stage run; renderer comparison is one run per variant, not a statistical SLA.
Windows D3D11/DPR1.5, 20 synthetic tasks; observations are process private commit/private working set, not GPU bytes or full heap attribution.
Excluded OBJ03 cold sample: main window visible but not exposed/scene-graph initialized.
Final native image/animation probe passed two themes/six transitions and restored operation-icon foreground-pixel assertions. Early trials did not cover these foreground pixels.
MSVC production binaries, multi-hour stability, physical multi-screen/accessibility and non-Windows platforms are not represented by this local measurement.
rendererDecision: GeometryRenderer with existing bounded MSAA retained. CurveRenderer experiment rejected after native restored-window icon visibility regression; Glyph drawing is recreated only for ink/path changes to fix stale theme material.
